findings.summary: Canonical verifier rejects missing required globs and --write target violations, but not partial deletion, empty non-required policy files, hash drift or new policy files (E4c/E4e).
Any change to a policy-scoped file, including the verifier itself, invalidates a baseline (E5a); integration needs a same-PR baseline regeneration rule and a protected baseline location.
Policy authority is unresolved between verifier POLICY_GLOBS and the M0-03 execution profile policySources (E4n); both sources preserved.
PowerShell shim encoding defect reproduced (E1) and fixed by P2 in a worktree copy (E6).
